title: Senior Graphic Designer – Video + Static
description:
**Build Ideas. Lead Creativity. Make Brands Matter.**

At Stratist, we believe great creative is not just about making something look good.

It should capture attention, communicate clearly, create emotion, and drive action.

We work with hospitals, healthcare brands, founders, and organisations to build brands and growth systems that create meaningful impact.

We’re looking for a Senior Graphic Designer – Video \+ Static who can bring ideas to life across formats — while also taking ownership of the creative output of a growing design team.

This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will design, shoot, edit, conceptualise, review, guide, and occasionally get into the details when the project demands it.

**What You’ll Own**  
01 — CREATE

Turn briefs and ideas into compelling visual experiences.

You’ll work across:

* Social media creatives and carousels
* Campaign creatives and digital ads
* Reels, short\-form videos and video content
* Video thumbnails and promotional creatives
* Presentations and pitch decks
* Brochures, posters and offline collaterals
* Brand assets and visual communication
* Internal Stratist creatives and campaigns

Your role is not just to execute a brief, but to understand the objective behind it and bring your creative thinking to the table.

02 — CONCEPTUALISE

We want someone who can think beyond templates.

You’ll be expected to:

* Develop creative concepts and campaign ideas
* Translate marketing objectives into visual communication
* Build creative directions for campaigns
* Suggest better ways to communicate an idea
* Explore new visual styles, formats and trends
* Maintain consistency across different brand touchpoints
* Balance creativity with business and communication objectives

Think first. Design second.

03 — LEAD

You will also be responsible for guiding a team of designers.

You’ll:

* Lead and coordinate the day\-to\-day design workflow
* Distribute and prioritise creative requirements
* Review designs before final delivery
* Maintain quality and brand consistency
* Give constructive feedback to junior designers
* Mentor and train team members
* Help designers improve their creative and technical skills
* Set expectations around quality, timelines and ownership
* Step in and solve complex design challenges when required

You won’t just be the best designer in the room.

You’ll help make the whole team better.

04 — SHOOT \& EDIT

We’re looking for someone comfortable beyond the design desk.

You may be involved in:

* Basic to advanced video shoots
* Camera handling and framing
* Healthcare/client shoots
* Interviews and testimonial recordings
* Reels and short\-form video production
* Video editing and post\-production
* Creating content for campaigns and social media
* Working with the marketing and creative team during shoots

You don’t need to be a full\-time filmmaker — but you should be comfortable picking up a camera and making things happen.

05 — CLIENT \& PROJECT OWNERSHIP

You may work directly with clients on assigned projects.

You’ll be expected to:

* Understand client requirements
* Convert discussions into clear creative deliverables
* Present and explain creative concepts
* Take feedback constructively
* Manage revisions professionally
* Own projects from brief → concept → execution → final delivery

Ensure timelines and quality standards are met  
Portfolio is mandatory.  
If your portfolio demonstrates strong design thinking, visual storytelling, video capability and creative ownership, we'd love to see it

What We’re Looking For  
Design \& Creative

* 2–4 years of professional design experience
* Strong portfolio demonstrating static \+ video work
* Strong command of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator
* Good experience with video editing tools such as Premiere Pro / After Effects / DaVinci Resolve
* Figma knowledge is a plus
* Strong understanding of typography, composition, colour and visual hierarchy
* Good understanding of branding and visual storytelling
* Strong creative conceptualisation skills

Leadership

* Experience guiding or mentoring junior designers
* Ability to review work and provide actionable feedback
* Ability to manage multiple creative requirements simultaneously
* Comfortable taking ownership of team\-level creative output
* Ability to prioritise work based on urgency and impact

Personality \& Work Style

We’re looking for someone who:

* Thinks creatively but executes practically
* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions
* Has strong attention to detail
* Is comfortable with feedback
* Communicates clearly
* Can handle deadlines without compromising quality
* Is curious about new creative formats and technologies
* Can work independently while collaborating with a larger team
* Is willing to get hands\-on when the project demands it

You’ll Have an Advantage If You,

* Have worked with healthcare, hospitals, education, startups or professional brands
* Have experience creating performance marketing creatives
* Understand how design influences engagement and conversions
* Have experience with photography or videography
* Have led a small design team
* Have experience presenting designs to clients
* Understand social media content formats and trends
* Experiment with AI\-powered creative tools
* Can think strategically about creative, not just visually

​  
The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

You might be a great fit if you see yourself as:

Designer \+ Creator \+ Problem Solver \+ Mentor

You care about the smallest alignment in a layout.

You notice when a video doesn't feel right.

You can turn a rough idea into a strong visual.

You can tell a junior designer why something needs to change — not just what needs to change.

And when something important needs to get done, you don't wait for someone else to take ownership.

You make it happen.​

BenefitsWhat You’ll Get at Stratist  
Work That Matters

Work on brands and projects that directly impact healthcare, people and communities.

Creative Ownership

You’ll have the opportunity to bring your ideas to the table — not simply execute someone else’s brief.

Leadership Exposure

Build your experience in creative leadership, team management and client handling.

Diverse Projects

Work across healthcare, branding, digital marketing, campaigns, video, technology and business communication.

Learn \& Grow

Access to Stratist Academy upskilling sessions and continuous exposure to new tools, technologies and ideas.

Work With Smart People

Collaborate with strategists, marketers, performance specialists, developers, healthcare leaders and founders.

A Culture of Ownership  
We value people who take responsibility, ask better questions, solve problems and make things happen.

.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

* What is your expected monthly salary?
* Do you work on video editing?
* Do you make graphic designs?
* How many years of experience do you have in this field?

title: Product Designer, Amazon Pay India
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


At Amazon, we're working to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Amazon Pay India's mission is to be India's most convenient, rewarding, and trusted way to pay. We're seeking a creative and customer\-obsessed Product Designer to join our team and help shape the future of digital payments in India.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design innovative and frictionless payment experiences for Amazon Pay's multiple use\-cases, including Rewards, Automatic Payments, Post Transaction Experience, and Bill Payments.
* Develop and maintain scalable design systems that can be applied across various payment scenarios, adhering to Amazon's design principles.
* Utilize data\-driven insights and conduct user research to inform design decisions, aligning with Amazon's culture of measuring everything.
* Create wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs that effectively communicate concepts throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and organizational leaders to ideate and deliver best\-in\-class experiences for our customers and partners.
* Champion Amazon's customer\-centric approach by advocating for user needs and translating insights into actionable design solutions.
* Contribute to key research studies to better understand user behaviors, needs, and motivations in the digital payments space.
* Work cross\-functionally with teams across Amazon to ensure cohesive design implementation and alignment with broader company goals.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1\+ years of design experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior Visual Designer & Video Editor
description:
Senior Visual Designer \& Video EditorJob Summary

We are looking for a highly creative and experienced **Senior Visual Designer \& Video Editor** to develop engaging visual content across digital, social media, marketing, branding, and video platforms.

The ideal candidate should have strong graphic design fundamentals along with hands\-on experience in **video editing, motion graphics, and digital content creation**. The role requires someone who can independently take a creative brief from concept to final execution while maintaining strong visual and brand consistency.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop creative concepts and visual designs for digital, social media, marketing, campaigns, presentations, and brand communications.
* Edit and produce high\-quality videos for social media, marketing campaigns, advertisements, internal communications, and other digital platforms.
* Create engaging short\-form content such as **Reels, Shorts, promotional videos, and social media creatives**.
* Develop storyboards, visual concepts, video sequences, transitions, titles, and motion graphics.
* Maintain brand consistency across static and video content.
* Collaborate with marketing, content, social media, and other teams to understand briefs and deliver creative solutions.
* Manage projects from concept development through final artwork/video delivery.
* Create animations, kinetic typography, transitions, and basic motion graphics where required.
* Retouch images, create compositions, and prepare digital assets for various platforms.
* Review creative work and ensure high standards of visual quality and accuracy.
* Manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Stay updated with current design, video, social media, and visual\-content trends.
* Mentor junior designers/editors and provide creative direction when required.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* **5\+ years of professional experience** in graphic/visual design, with significant hands\-on video editing experience.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating both **graphic design and video editing** work.
* Advanced knowledge of **Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro**.
* Working knowledge of **After Effects** for motion graphics and animation.
* Experience with **Figma** or other digital design tools is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of typography, color, composition, layout, branding, and visual storytelling.
* Strong video\-editing skills including pacing, transitions, audio synchronization, color correction, and basic sound editing.
* Experience creating content for Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms.
* Ability to convert creative briefs into compelling visual and video content.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.

Preferred Skills

* Motion graphics and animation.
* Short\-form/social\-media video production.
* Basic knowledge of photography and videography.
* Experience with AI\-assisted design and video tools.
* Understanding of current social\-media content formats and trends.
* Experience working with brand guidelines and integrated marketing campaigns.

Key Competencies

* Creative and conceptual thinking
* Visual storytelling
* Graphic design
* Video editing
* Motion graphics
* Brand awareness
* Attention to detail
* Communication and collaboration
* Time management
* Problem\-solving

Experience

**3 \-4\+ years of relevant experience**, including substantial experience in video editing and digital content creation.

Reporting To

**Creative Director / Design Head / Art Director / Marketing Head**

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: User Interface Designer
description:
Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? At Siemens Healthineers, we pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere.  

We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone to grow both personally and professionally. Sound interesting?  

Then come and join our global design and user experience community as a **User Interface Design Professional (UID)** and use your visual expertise to create high\-quality product experiences. Working closely with UX designers and developers, you will help deliver meaningful healthcare solutions through human\-centered design and innovation.  

As part of our team, you will be welcomed into a supportive and collaborative UX community, contribute to meaningful medical software that helps healthcare professionals every day, benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities, and collaborate with colleagues in an international and cross\-cultural environment. **Please upload your portfolio with your application.** **Your tasks and responsibilities:**  

As a **User Interface Designer**, you will play a key role in shaping high\-quality interfaces for products used by thousands of healthcare professionals worldwide. You work at the intersection of visual design, usability, clinical reality and technical implementation, creating interfaces that are clear, consistent, feasible and genuinely helpful in critical moments.  

In this role, you will **design user interfaces** for innovative solutions in the field of Advanced Therapies used during minimally invasive procedures.  

Your work will help interventional teams quickly understand complex clinical information and make confident decisions, from imaging through to intervention. A particular focus will be on clinical and sterile environments, where safety, efficiency and usability are essential.* Design and refine user interfaces across a wide range of touchpoints, ensuring visual clarity, consistency, and usability within complex clinical workflows.
* Create high\-fidelity, pixel\-perfect user interfaces using our advanced design system, and deliver clear, implementation\-ready design specifications for development teams.
* Conduct design quality reviews of implemented software and collaborate with engineering teams to enhance visual consistency and implementation quality across products.
* Work closely with UX Researchers, Interaction Designers, Industrial Designers, and Developers in cross\-functional teams to translate design concepts into high\-quality product experiences.
* Partner with frontend engineers throughout handoff and implementation to ensure design intent, visual details, and interactions are accurately realized in the final product.
* Gain firsthand insight into clinical environments by participating in hospital and practice shadowing sessions to develop a deep understanding of users, their needs, and their workflows.
**Your qualifications and experience*** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication Design, Media Design, User Interface Design, or a related field, with exceptional visual expertise
* A strong portfolio demonstrating your visual design craftsmanship, digital product experience and problem\-solving skills
* 7\+ years of professional experience in an agency or in\-house UX team, with a substantial digital\-focused portfolio.
* High proficiency in design tools such as Figma and a strong understanding of design systems at scale.
* Good understanding of how user interfaces are implemented in software products, including HTML, CSS and component\-based frontend architectures.
* Proven experience partnering with software development teams, creating implementation\-ready design specifications, and conducting design quality reviews to ensure accurate implementation and adherence to design system standards.
* Experience in medical technology is a plus; curiosity and willingness to dive deep into complex clinical workflows are even more important.
**Your attributes and skills*** Strong visual design skills, including expertise in layout, typography, color, visual hierarchy, composition, and visual concept development.
* A user\-centered, design\-driven mindset with a strong focus on clarity, usability, and product quality.
* Passion for design craftsmanship, implementation quality, and detail\-oriented collaboration throughout the product development process, from concept to final delivery.
* A collaborative team player who enjoys working closely with UX, development, and cross\-functional partner teams across Siemens Healthineers
**Your Mindset*** Forward\-thinking and quality\-driven mindset: You stay curious, bring fresh ideas, and understand how exceptional UI design contributes to outstanding product experiences and business success.
* Collaborative ownership mindset: You build strong partnerships across disciplines, take ownership of design outcomes, and are committed to quality fom initial concept through final implementation.
* Continuous learning mindset: You actively seek opportunities to learn, stay current with emerging UX and UI practices, and continuously develop your skills to enhance your impact on the team.

To gain a deeper understanding of the products and services related to this role, please explore these links and visit our company website for more details. https://www.siemens\-healthineers.com/products\-services  

Our global team:
We are a team of 66,000 highly dedicated employees across more than 70 countries passionately pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in healthcare to help improve people’s lives around the world. As a leader in the industry, we aspire to create better outcomes and experiences for patients no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio, spanning from in\-vitro and in\-vivo diagnostics to image\-guided therapy and innovative cancer care, is crucial for clinical decision\-making and treatment pathways.  

Our culture:
We are part of an incredible community of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, to improve people’s lives around the world. We embrace a culture of inclusivity in which the power and potential of every individual can be unleashed. We spark ideas that lead to positive impact and continued success. Check our Careers Site  

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.  

We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open.  

To all recruitment agencies: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Lead Designer
description:
**Job Description:**

**Our journey**

Based in London, with roots in India, e9 has developed highly motivated talent into productive teams across continents. At e9, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. We are ambitious with a pace to match, and as part of a fast\-growing company, the opportunity and ability to push forward are greater than ever before. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there is no telling what you could accomplish.

**Who you will work with**

We foster a culture of continuous improvement in a diverse and inclusive workplace where people feel valued and included. Accountability matters. At e9, we bring together remarkable people and enable them to be themselves as part of a collaborative team that is helping to innovate.

Do you have a passionate desire to produce great designs? Are you looking for an environment where you can push your work and yourself? Are you a team player? Does your passion for design border on the absurd? Are you naturally caffeinated? Ridiculously positive and upbeat? If so, e9 may be the place for you.

**Job Title: Lead Brand \& Product Designer Role Overview**

We are looking for a **Lead Designer** to take ownership of our brand identity and visual systems, with the support of our current in\-house Graphic Designer. In this role, you will define, evolve, and execute our brand across every touchpoint \- from high\-impact marketing campaigns to our digital product ecosystem. Splitting your time between our **Marketing** and **Product** teams, you will act as the guardian of our visual language, ensuring seamless brand consistency, exceptional user experiences, and high\-quality creative output across both physical and digital media.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* **Brand Strategy \& Visual Identity:** Define, evolve, and maintain our overall brand strategy, guidelines, and visual identity systems across physical assets (print, packaging, event collateral) and digital touchpoints.
* **Cross\-Functional Design Execution:** Work closely with our Marketing Lead and Product Team to conceptualise, prototype, and deliver high\-level creative solutions from brief through final production.
* **Product \& Digital Experience:** Translate brand identity into user\-centred product experiences by creating wireframes, interactive prototypes, user interface (UI) components, and polished assets ready for front\-end development.
* **Marketing \& Campaign Collateral:** Lead the visual design for marketing campaigns, website banners, landing pages, email templates, social media graphics, and printed materials.
* **Design Systems \& Asset Management:** Build and maintain a scalable design system (UI kit, typography scale, iconography, component libraries) that aligns both marketing collateral and digital product UI.
* **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Oversee design workflows from early\-stage conceptualisation and mood boards to pre\-flight print checks and digital asset handoffs for developers.

**What You’ll Need to Make the Most of the Role**

* **5 \- 6\+ years of experience** in a design role (agency, in\-house, or high\-level freelance) with a strong portfolio demonstrating leadership in both brand identity development and digital product design (UI/UX).
* **A deep passion for brand identity and brand development**, with a proven track record of creating cohesive visual systems across physical and digital mediums.
* **Strong affinity for UX/UI design**, including a firm grasp of standard UX best practices, design thinking, visual hierarchy, and web/app design fundamentals.
* **End\-to\-end production skills:** Ability to produce high\-level design solutions at every stage \- from wireframing and interactive prototyping to delivering polished, development\-ready assets.
* **Expert proficiency in industry\-standard tools:** Figma (for product/UI design systems) and Adobe Creative Cloud (*Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign*).
* **Cross\-functional leadership \& communication:** Ability to collaborate seamlessly with marketing leads, developers, and creative peers, clearly presenting design rationale and incorporating feedback effectively.
* **Resourcefulness under deadline:** Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and deliver high\-quality work in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* **Positive, upbeat, happy approach** to creative collaboration, work, and life.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with **animation and motion design** for web and product UI (*After Effects, Lottie, Rive*).
* Basic understanding of **front\-end development** (*HTML, CSS, JavaScript*) to facilitate smoother handoffs with engineering teams.
* Experience using **3D software** (*Blender, Cinema 4D*) to create unique brand or product visuals.
* Experience managing external vendors, printers, and packaging suppliers for physical brand assets.

**Submission Requirements:**

* Portfolio of work
* Successful second\-round applicants will be required to submit a company\-related at\-home task.

title: Lead Designer (Manager) : DAP
description:
**Who are we?**



Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human\-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.



At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real\-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.



This intelligence powers our entire product suite.


* Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster.
* Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps.
* Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments.


These are ur embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance.



Our upcoming AI\-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.


* Seek is an AI\-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf.
* Whatfix Mirror 2\.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category
* Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise\-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers.
* Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement—ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome\-driven for every employee.
* At Whatfix, we’re not just making software easier—we’re making AI work for people.
* The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40\+ countries.
* Customers: 700\+ enterprise customers, including 80\+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.
* Investors: A total of \~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2\. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.


**Whatfix’s leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings:**


* Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI\-based Analytics Solution of the Year
* Only DAP to be recognized as a “Leader” across various DAP reports for the past 5\+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.
* With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.
* Named a Gartner Customers’ Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025\)—the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively.
* We also boast a star rating of 4\.6 on G2 Crowd, 4\.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super\-high CSAT of 99\.8%
* Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year – Computer Software \- 100 or More Employees.
* Winner of the ISG Paragon Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category.
* RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for “Software Asset Management Solution of the Year”
  


**These recognitions are matched by business performance:**


* Highest\-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fifth Consecutive Year
* Listed on the Financial Times \& Statista's High\-Growth Companies Asia\-Pacific 2025 list.
* Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022\-2023
* Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal
* Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion\-dollar company!
  


**About the Role**



We’re looking for a Design Lead to join our Product Design and UXUser Research team, where you'll help define our DAP experience strategy and guide a team of talented designers toward successful outcomes.



This role is both strategic and hands\-on, ideal for someone who thrives in a player\-coach capacity. You'll play a key role in expanding the DAP category and shaping how our multiple products work together to create greater value, developing strategies that seamlessly integrate them to drive cohesive, user\-centered solutions across the ecosystem.



As a design leader, you can coach and support your teams to thrive in fast\-paced, hyper\-growth environments. You’ll have experience working with product and engineering leaders throughout the product development life\-cycle as you manage and support your design team.



Our designers are strong strategic thinkers and problem solvers who work on industry\-defining innovations that are creating a new category. As our ideal candidate, you can oversee, support, and empower the designers to do their best work. You’re capable of zooming out to set the team vision and drilling down to the details to help solution and assess the polish of the work.



You understand the importance of building a strong team culture, building trust, creating collaborative relationships with our product and engineering partners to innovative solutions through human\-centered design, and upskilling everyone around them in the process.


**What you’ll do**


* **Lead and manage Design for our DAP Tribe, one of 4 Tribes within Whatfix**
* Work with Design leadership and cross\-functional partners to align DAP strategy to overall business goals and product strategy.
* Help to define the DAP design vision that supports our product strategy and actively align design teams efforts to achieve it.
* Drive the design quality, practice, and offerings for our DAP product line that meet our business, customer, and end\-user goals.
* Lead and mentor a team of DAP designers through the end\-to\-end design process, championing and encouraging innovation, creative thinking, new ideas and solutions.
* Own craft and capability output across key DAP projects, ensuring each project deliverable is of the highest quality and meets the Design teams defined standards.
* Represent the needs and voice of the user wrt to our DAP offering, championing these needs with cross\-functional partners to help prioritize planning and process.
* Act as a strategic partner to product and technology leads on DAP to ensure prioritization and delivery of key products and features through an inclusive design process.
* Assess performance and provide career guidance for members of the DAP design team.
  


**What We’re Looking For:**


* **Industry Experience: 8\-12 years relevant industry experience, with 2\-3 of those years managing designers as a player\-coach.** We’re looking for **design leaders who know when and how to roll up their sleeves to multiply their teams.**
* Fostering Creative Environments: Experience creating environments where design teams can do high\-quality, creative, hypothesis\-driven work.
* Human centered approach: Proven experience with driving and applying human\-centered design processes while collaborating with customers, engineering, product management, and user researchers.
* Collaborative Mindset: Strong communicator and team player, comfortable working across product teams to break down silos and drive collective success.
* Craftsmanship \& Execution: A deep commitment to design excellence and attention to detail, ensuring user\-centered solutions are validated and aligned with business goals.
* Strong Portfolio: A strong portfolio that represents the outcomes of your approach, contributions as a design leader, and shipped work to a mass market.
* Proactive communicator: Highly proactive with exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
  


**Why You’ll Love This Role:**


* Our team is at the forefront of building and expanding the DAP category. You’ll have the chance to lead cutting\-edge design projects that truly shape how people interact with digital tools.
* You’ll coach your team to thrive in a fast\-paced, hyper\-growth environment while driving innovation through human\-centered design.
* As a catalyst for creativity, you’ll work on solving complex, diverse challenges that deliver real value for our customers and our business.


**Reporting Structure: This role reports directly to the Global Head of Product Research and Design.**

  

**\#LI\#Onsite**  

**\#WorkType: \#Onsite**

title: Lead UI/UX Designer
description:
As the UX Lead for our ServiceNow platform, you will drive consistency across our UX and UI, document and own the standards that get us there, and build the design system and practice that make great experiences repeatable  

rather than accidental. This is a hands on leadership role. You will set the design direction and build it, in UI Builder and in React.

  

This is a pivotal moment for experience on our platform. We are raising our ambition from enterprise tolerable to consumer grade, moving beyond a traditional ITSM mindset to design solutions our users genuinely want to use.You will own the success and adoption of what we ship, not just the design behind it.


You will establish a formal UX practice on the platform from the ground up and lead the designers and developers  

who join it. Strong stakeholder management and communication are central to the role. You will be the advocate for experience who aligns product, engineering, and business around a shared bar for quality, and holds us to it.


What you will do  

UX Standards and Consistency  

* Own and document the UX and UI standards for the platform, and drive their adoption across every team building on ServiceNow.
* Build and own a design system and component library so that consistency is built in, not policed after the fact.
* Establish design patterns, guidelines, and reusable components that raise the floor on every solution we ship.
* Define what “good” looks like on the platform and hold teams to it through design reviews and clear standards.

Consumer Grade Experience and Adoption  

* Move the platform beyond a traditional ITSM mindset and design solutions where the experience is consumer grade.
* Own the success and adoption of the solutions we ship. Define what adoption looks like, measure it, and use


it to drive design decisions.  

* Partner with product and business teams to make sure we are solving the real user problem, not just delivering the requested feature.
* Bring an outside\-in view of quality, benchmarked against the consumer products our users actually compare us to.
  

  

Hands On Design and Build  

* Design and build experiences directly in UI Builder and the Now Experience Framework.
* Write front\-end code in React to build components, prototypes, and production experiences where native tooling is not enough.
* Move fluidly between design and implementation so that what gets shipped matches what was designed.
* Set front\-end engineering standards for the UX work on the platform.

User Research and Accessibility  

* Stand up a user research practice. Talk to real users, run usability testing, and bring evidence to design decisions rather than opinion.
* Own accessibility on the platform. Make sure what we build meets WCAG standards and works for everyone, and build accessibility into the design system rather than retrofitting it.
* Turn research and accessibility from checkboxes into a genuine part of how the team works.

Mobile Experience  

* Extend the same consumer grade bar to mobile. Our mobile experience is a strength today and this role keeps it that way as the platform grows.
* Design and build mobile experiences that are first class, not afterthoughts, across ServiceNow mobile apps and mobile web.

Building the UX Practice and Team  

* Establish a formal UX practice on the platform from scratch: the standards, the tools, the rituals, and the ways of working.
* Hire, lead, and grow a team of UX designers and developers, and build a culture where craft and user obsession are the norm.
* Mentor the team and raise the level of design and front\-end work across everyone building on the platform.

Stakeholder Management and Communication  

* Be the advocate for experience across product, engineering, operations, and business, and align them around a shared bar for quality.
* Communicate design decisions clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive leadership, and bring people along rather than mandating.
* Make the case for investment in UX and show the return through adoption and outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications  

* Deep hands on experience with ServiceNow native UX capabilities, including UI Builder and the Now Experience Framework, across workspaces, portals, and Employee Center.
* Hands on front\-end development experience with React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with the ability to build production experiences directly.
* Proven track record building and owning a design system and component library adopted across multiple teams.
* Experience establishing and documenting UX and UI standards and driving their adoption at scale.
* Hands on user research experience, including usability testing and translating findings into design decisions.
* Strong accessibility expertise, including WCAG 2\.1 / 2\.2 and designing for assistive technologies.
* A portfolio that shows consumer grade enterprise experiences, and the judgment to move a platform beyond legacy and ITSM era patterns.
* Proven people leadership. You have built or led a team of designers and developers.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including with executive leadership.
* Experience owning the adoption and success of what you ship, and measuring it.
* Proficiency with Figma or equivalent design and prototyping tools.
* 8\+ years in UX and UI design, with meaningful time in a lead or player\-coach capacity.

Preferred Qualifications  

* ServiceNow certifications related to UX, UI Builder, or application development (e.g., CSA, CAD).
* Hands on experience with ServiceNow mobile, including Now Mobile and the mobile app builder.
* Experience standing up a UX or design ops practice inside an organization that previously had none.
* Experience turning around the reputation of a platform or product that had outgrown its original design.
* Familiarity with Employee Center Pro intranet and portal experiences.
* Experience with design system tooling such as Storybook, design tokens, and component documentation.
* Interaction and motion design skills, and UX writing or content design experience.
* Experience working with large scale enterprise design systems.

Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. description:
**Role Overview**


As a UX Designer at NETGEAR, you will craft intuitive, engaging interfaces for our enterprise and consumer networking products. You’ll partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Visual Design teams to translate complex networking concepts into clear, user\-centered experiences across web, mobile, and desktop platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **User Research:** Plan and conduct usability studies, interviews, and surveys to uncover user needs and pain points.
* **Interaction Design:** Develop wireframes, user flows, and prototypes that illustrate product functionality and user journeys.
* **Visual \& Information Design:** Create high\-fidelity mockups and design specs aligned with NETGEAR’s brand and design system.
* **AI\-Assisted Design \& Prototyping:** Use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Figma Make, and other AI\-powered UX tools to accelerate ideation, research synthesis, UX writing, design exploration, and rapid prototyping.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively across devices.
* **Iteration \& Validation:** Gather feedback from stakeholders and end users; iterate designs to optimize usability and performance.
* **Documentation:** Maintain and evolve our UX guidelines, component libraries, and style documentation.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 10\+ years of complete UX Design experience, preferably on B2B, SaaS, enterprise, or networking products.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree preferably in UX/UI Design, Human–Computer Interaction (HCI), Graphic Design, or related field.
* **Tools \& Skills:**


	+ Strong proficiency with Figma (components, auto\-layout, prototyping).
	+ Experience with Figma Make and AI\-assisted prototyping workflows.
	+ Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, and other emerging AI tools for UX research, ideation, UX writing, and rapid prototyping.
	+ Familiarity with usability testing tools (e.g., UserTesting, Maze).
	+ Solid foundation in graphic design (typography, color, layout).
	+ Experience with web \& mobile app design strategies.
	+ Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and responsive design principles.
	+ Experience with AI tools for UX and product design.
* **Attributes:**


	+ Strong empathy and communication skills, able to articulate design choices.
	+ Analytical mindset with a focus on data\-driven design decisions.
	+ Ability to learn networking concepts quickly and translate them into user workflows.
	+ Collaborative spirit and comfort working in Agile/Scrum environments.
	+ A portfolio showcasing design process and outcomes.

**Company Statement/Values:**


At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.


We're a performance\-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world\-class products for our customers. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.


We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward\-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.

*NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*

title: Delightree - Senior Design Engineer
description:
### **About the role**


This role splits roughly in half.


The first half is designing for franchise operations \- multi location brands, franchisee owners, and frontline staff each needing something different from the same product.


The second half is owning the layer between design and code. You'll own the design system \- the components, patterns, and code. You'll write frontend code yourself, and you'll define how design work becomes a shipped interface for everyone else on the team.


That second half is why this role exists. Our approach to product development is shifting. Instead of traditional mockup handoffs, product managers and designers directly build working prototypes directly in code, using AI workflows alongside our component library. Engineering builds on those prototypes rather than starting over. You own this system and ensure it's up to scale and quality.

### **What you'll do**

* Design and build UI in the same motion \- prototyping novel AI\-native interactions directly in code rather than in Figma\-then\-handoff, especially where no pattern library exists yet.
* Sit inside a pod (PM \+ eng lead \+ you) and take features from concept to shipped, rather than handing off a spec and waiting.
* Own the interaction and motion details \- loading/streaming states, transitions, micro\-interactions \- the polish that's nearly impossible to fully spec in a doc.
* Build and maintain shared UI components so the rest of the org can move fast without reinventing patterns feature by feature.
* Work directly in the production codebase.

### **What we're looking for**

* 4\+ years in product design, with depth in dense interfaces \- tables, forms, permissions, multi role flows.
* Real product/visual design judgment *and* the ability to ship real frontend code \- not a designer who dabbles in code or an engineer who cares about UI, but someone for whom design and implementation are the same skill.
* Hands\-on frontend engineering. A portfolio \+ GitHub showing shipped, interactive, polished products \- not just mockups or case studies.
* Design systems built and maintained at scale, in code. You should be able to direct AI tools to build and maintain prototypes that adhere to accessibility, component system, and other guardrails.
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-native interfaces: streaming output, agentic/human\-in\-the\-loop UX, confidence and uncertainty in UI.
* Bonus: has worked somewhere small enough that design and engineering weren't separate functions. AI used structurally in how features got shipped, from ideation through implementation and review \- not just for copy or asset generation.
